question: What is the main purpose of a CCTV inspection of a gravity sewer?
correctAnswer: To view the inside of the pipe and locate defects and obstructions
explanation: A CCTV camera shows the condition inside the pipe so defects, deposits, and obstructions can be located and recorded.

To view the inside of the pipe and locate defects and obstructions
To remove roots from the pipe wall
To measure the pumping rate at a lift station
optionA: To increase the flow capacity of the pipe
optionB: To view the inside of the pipe and locate defects and obstructions
